czar:
n. a male monarch or emperor (especially of Russia prior to 1917)
n. a person having great power

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>「某領域主管」一義為非正式，帶有誇張色彩</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>俄語 tsar，源自哥德語 kaisar，再溯至希臘語與拉丁 Caesar（凱撒）</dd><dt>字族</dt><dd>czarist (形容詞)</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a drug czar；an education czar；a banking czar</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">也可拼作 tsar；指俄國君主時多用大寫 Czar 加人名</dd></dl>
czardas: <dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">匈牙利語 csárdás</dd></dl>
czarevitch: <dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">俄語 tsarevich，源自 tsar' ＋ -evich（父名字尾）</dd></dl>
czarina: n. 沙皇皇后, 女沙皇
n. the wife or widow of a czar
czarist:
n. 沙皇追隨者, 擁護獨裁政治者
a. 沙皇的
a. of or relating to or characteristic of a czar
